note: Proposed, reversible boundary contract. Nothing here is Graph Lang semantics; the runtime is unverified.

layers.representation: Versioned graph document (labels, matrix) treated as data. Loading it is not execution.
layers.navigation: Browser selection/routing over representation; no evaluation.
layers.evaluation: Runtime adapter: evaluate(request) -> result|error. Requires documented Graph Lang runtime.
layers.persistent_state: Persistence adapter: load/save with expected revision. Independent of evaluation.

invariants: revision increases by exactly 1 on each successful save
failed or conflicting save leaves stored document and revision unchanged
document must be a JSON object with schema_version, labels (strings), matrix (square, null|1)

evaluation_cases.reason: no documented Graph Lang execution contract (graphlang P0/P2 requests)

evaluation_cases.expect: browser shows error unavailable, never a mock success

local_sqlite_reference: simulated failed write leaves state unchanged
